title: Dashboard Config
description: Per-client config describing conversion taxonomy, filters, calculated fields, blends and metrics for a Looker Studio lead-gen report. Generated from a Google Ads account's Conversions settings, not scraped from Looker Studio.

report_template.description: Name of the Looker Studio template report this config is meant to be applied to, e.g. 'gads-leadgen-v1'.

notes.description: Freeform notes for whoever configures this client next.

locations.description: Optional: for multi-location/multi-account clients (one Google Ads account per location, or several locations sharing one account via campaigns). Drives one repeated report block per location. Omit entirely for single-location clients like Peneder.

status.description: 'pending' = no data source and/or tracking not firing yet; render as a placeholder block instead of real numbers.

data_source.description: Key into data_sources. Omit when status is 'pending'.

campaign_filter.description: If this location shares a data_source with others (e.g. two cities in one account), the match rule that isolates this location's campaigns within that source.

data_sources.description: Keys are local source aliases referenced elsewhere in this file (e.g. by filters.field's implicit source, or blends.legs.source).

label.description: Human label matching the Looker Studio data source name, e.g. 'Google Ads MCC'.

conversion_actions.description: Raw inventory pulled from Google Ads → Tools & Settings → Conversions for this account. This is the ground truth; lead_categories below classify these.

name.description: Exact conversion action name as shown in Google Ads.

account.description: Key into data_sources this action belongs to. Required when data_sources has more than one entry (multi-account clients); omit for single-account clients.

ads_category.description: Google Ads' own category, e.g. 'Submit lead form', 'Phone call leads', 'Contact'.

status.description: Mirrors Google Ads' own Tracking-Status column (Aktiv=enabled, Entfernt=removed, Warten auf Conversions=pending, Falsch konfiguriert=misconfigured, Überprüfung erforderlich=needs_review, Keine kürzlich erfassten Conversions=no_recent_activity).

source.description: Flags noise imported from GA4/local actions so it can be excluded from lead_categories entirely.

lead_categories.description: Buckets that group conversion_actions into meaningful lead types. One category should be a catch_all named 'other' to surface anything unclassified instead of silently dropping it.

label.description: Display label used in filter/field names, e.g. 'Kontakt Telefon'.

group.description: Top-level grouping used to build the two summary buckets (Anfrage-Kontakt / Anfrage-Formular).

filters.description: Named, reusable filters — mirrors Looker Studio's Resource > Manage Filters list. Usually generated 1:1 from lead_categories plus one master filter and any exclude/'Sonstige' filters.

field.description: Field the condition applies to, e.g. 'Segment Conversion Type Name' or a calculated_fields name.

derived_from.description: Optional: which lead_categories key(s) this filter was generated from, for traceability.

calculated_fields.description: CASE-style bucket fields built from lead_categories, e.g. 'Anfrage-Kontakt', 'Anfrage-Formular'.

default.description: Value for anything not matched by cases — typically 'Sonstige'.

blends.description: Each blend joins the same source against itself at one grain: one unfiltered leg (for cost/clicks/impressions) and one lead-filtered leg (for lead counts), so ratio metrics can be computed across both.

location.description: Key into locations, when this blend is scoped to one location (multi-location clients).

grain.description: Dimensions this blend is aggregated to, e.g. ['Kampagne'] or ['Tag'].

filter.description: Name of a filters entry applied to this leg, null for unfiltered, or an array of filter names AND-combined (e.g. a channel filter plus a location's campaign_filter when several locations share one data source).

join_keys.description: Empty for a totals-level blend with no grain to join on.

metrics.description: Derived metrics computed across a blend's legs, e.g. Cost per Lead = unfiltered.Cost / leads.Leads Conv.

location.description: Key into locations, when this metric is scoped to one location.

blend.description: Name of the blends entry this metric is computed on.

formula.description: Expression referencing '<leg alias>.<field>', e.g. 'unfiltered.Cost / leads.Leads Conv.'.
